relations.subject: server/8.0/eventing/eventing-handler-removeObjectStubs
relations.evidence: This function is a subset of the cleanup functionality found in the Scriptlet [removeNullsAndEmptys](eventing-handler-removeNullsAndEmptys.md).

notable_absence.finding: The removeEmptyParts function's [doc, changed-flag] tuple return is a hand-written JS optimization (documented as improving performance on subsequent runs when the Feed Boundary is set to Everything over large document sets) rather than a platform-level primitive - no Eventing-specific 'change detection' concept is exposed by the API itself. Content is byte-identical to the Capella twin apart from front matter; no disagreement found.
